messages:
maria: Heads up — app-of-apps sync is stuck on prune in us-west-2. ArgoCD controller keeps retrying and we're seeing a bunch of 429s from the cloud API. Observed around 10:04 UTC.

maria: argocd logs snippet:
```
time="2026-03-18T10:04:12Z" level=error msg="rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to prune resource: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests: Rate exceeded"
time="2026-03-18T10:04:13Z" level=warn msg="helm hook pre-delete failed: timeout waiting for hook pod"
time="2026-03-18T10:04:20Z" level=info msg="retrying operation (3/5)"
```

jamie: Oof. Looks like the app-of-apps triggers prune on ~120 child apps across regions simultaneously — controller parallelism + cloud API quotas = 429s.

jamie: Quick checks I ran: `kubectl top po -n argocd` shows controller CPU spikes, and cloud console shows spikes in GET/DELETE for load balancers and DNS entries in us-west-2.

ken: Is this only prune? or also syncs failing?

maria: Both. Prune is failing with 429, Helm pre-delete hook pods are timing out because the API calls to delete backing infra are throttled. Syncs keep queuing.

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-033 (auto). Runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/gitops-prune-throttle

liam: Short term mitigation options:
- Reduce controller concurrency: lower --operation-processors (or set replica env) to limit simultaneous operations.
- Apply sync-wave annotations to the biggest region-root child apps so prunes happen sequentially instead of all at once.
- Add a small backoff in our Helm hooks for infra deletion (retry loop with 5s jitter).

jamie: I can scale argocd application-controller to 2 replicas and set `--operation-processors=5` for the controller pod. That should cut parallel API calls roughly in half. Doing it now on staging to validate.

maria: Please also push a quick Git change to the apps repo to add `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "10"` on the us-west-2 region-root app so it prunes after us-east. We'll roll that change and monitor.

ken: I noticed Terraform state also shows two orphaned external LB entries in us-west-2 from last month. If GitOps prunes try to remove those and cloud rate limiter kicks in, they may get stuck in cloud > git loops. We should mark them for manual removal or use a staggered delete plan.

liam: Agreed. My plan:
1) Emergency: scale controller replicas and lower operation-processors (jamie on this).
2) Repo patch: add sync-wave on region roots + split the big root into region buckets (maria + ken).
3) Infra: ken to manually remove or schedule Terraform apply that drains those orphan LBs with a rate-limited script.
4) Longer term: add a pruning rate-limiter plugin or leaky-bucket queue in front of ArgoCD prune operations.

maria: Patch PR created: https://github.com/redwood/gitops/commit/9f3a7d2 — adds `sync-wave` to us-west-2 root and a note in README about staggered prunes.

jamie: Controller scaled in staging and set to `--operation-processors=5`. Observing logs — 429s dropped by ~70% in staging within 10 mins. Will schedule the same change in prod during 11:30 maintenance window.

ops-bot: @here Maintenance window scheduled: 11:30 UTC — change controller flags, roll one-by-one (canary)

ken: Manual infra cleanup scheduled for 13:00 UTC; I will run a rate-limited `aws` script: `xargs -n1 -P1 -I{} sh -c "sleep $((RANDOM%4)); aws elbv2 delete-load-balancer --load-balancer-arn {}"` to avoid bursts.

maria: After the prod controller change and the sync-wave commit go in, I'll monitor app-of-apps for 1 hour and report back. If we still see >5% failure rate we'll pause automatic prune and run a controlled rollout.

liam: Thanks all. Follow-ups: add a short checklist to the runbook about region-pruning (who to ping, how to split app-of-apps, quick controller flags). I'll open that ticket.

maria: TL;DR: root cause = too many concurrent prune/delete operations across regions hitting provider quotas; mitigations = lower controller parallelism, stagger region prunes, manual cleanup for orphans, add retries/backoff in hooks.

jamie: Closing loop: staging looks healthy. Keeping incident open until prod window completes. :thumbsup:
